eventDetail.scope: The SSP Workshop is a unique meeting that brings together members of the IEEE Signal Processing Society and researchers from both academia and industry in fields associated with statistical signal processing and its applications. Following the SSP tradition, the workshop will offer a rich technical program with plenty of opportunities for discussion and interaction with colleagues. Plenary speakers will be sought to cover major aspects of statistical signal processing.
